scope: CPU proposal ranking on existing public development cases; all candidate certificates verified independently against the original source and question
split_note: Relation/multipremise cases and their ablation stay together. Train and validation share vocabulary and broader grammar. This is public development validation, not independent Arabic evaluation or joint root/template OOD.
acceptance: All 90 attempts measured; 18 original certificates accepted with authored statuses; 72 altered certificates rejected; exact source splits disjoint. Training failures retained; no accuracy target or claim of superiority to the current proposer.
promotion: Never promote a rank score to a semantic judgment. Never discard readings. Never treat UNKNOWN/DEFER semantic status as a bad certificate. Resource/setup failures yield null labels, not negative rewards.
linguistic_data: 36 published coverage cases enter a review queue only. No right-to-train or independent human gold is inferred from kernel acceptance or a repository license.
first_run: Output directory must not exist. Preserve failed and successful runs separately; changing the protocol creates a new experiment.
